title: Shola to Megenagna Corridor Moving Guide
excerpt: Shola–Megenagna corridor moves: Yeka school traffic, condo handovers, side-street truck staging, and links to Kotebe and Bole routes.
content:
The Shola–Megenagna axis

Moves along the Shola to Megenagna corridor stay within Yeka sub-city on the map but behave like cross-town jobs on the ground—narrow side streets, school-zone slowdowns, and junction congestion. Active Movers treats these as one planning zone: same dispatch pool, shared knowledge of which compounds allow weekend freight.

School zones and timing

Morning drop-off and afternoon pickup around schools along the corridor add 20–40 minutes of uncertainty. Schedule load-out after 9:30 or before 14:30 on weekdays when possible. Saturday moves are popular; book elevator slots in the first week of the month.

Truck staging

Main junction parking is limited. Crews often park one block off the arterial and trolley goods through guarded compounds. Your survey should note carry distance—quotes include crew size adjustments for long pushes.

Condo handovers

End-of-month handovers stack in Shola towers. Align move-out cleaning, key return, and elevator time with management in writing. Our move-out checklist helps avoid deposit disputes.

Short corridor moves

Shola to Megenagna on paper is a few kilometers; in practice traffic and staging can exceed an hour each way. Fixed quotes should reflect time bands, not only odometer distance—see hourly vs fixed pricing.

Retail spillover

Ground-floor shops along corridor arteries may restrict truck idling during business hours. Coordinate with shop owners if your load blocks customer parking—courtesy prevents day-of conflicts.

Weather and seasonal timing

Heavy rain on Yeka hillside compounds slows trolley runs and makes lift cab protection mandatory. During main rainy season, schedule indoor packing the day before so the truck focuses on load-only hours. Festival weeks may add police diversions near Megenagna—check holiday calendar before confirming.

FAQ

Is Shola the same price as Megenagna? Not automatically—carry distance, floor, and elevator rules differ by building. Can you move after school hours only? Yes, when booked in advance; overtime may apply on fixed quotes without a traffic clause. Who handles elevator deposits? You pay management per building rules; the mover follows the slot time in your permit.

Cross-town from the corridor

Megenagna loads heading to Bole, Kazanchis, or CMC cross junctions that punish late starts. Crews pad traffic time separately from map distance. If you are leaving Yeka for southwest condos, read Bole and Jemo & Lebu for destination gate rules.

Group moves in Shola towers

Two neighbors on the same freight calendar can share mobilization when management books one vendor—group discount tips. Each household keeps its own inventory list and declared value.
